test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 2 Feb 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: When was the National Green Tribunal established by the Government of India?
solution:
Correct answer is__** 2010.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The National Green Tribunal was established in **2010.**
 
• The National Green Tribunal Act is a specialised judicial body equipped with skill simply for the motive of **adjudicating environmental cases in the country.**
 
• The National Green Tribunal was set up under the **National Green Tribunal Act, 2010 (NGT Act).**
 
• The objective of the NGT Act is **to provide effective and expeditious disposal of cases relating to the protection of the environment.**
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bd3bfa56b985a6e471b4c5275c67399b0aecb04e8b4fcddbd225611f47b55e30.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The NGT has five places for sittings,** New Delhi** is the chief place of sitting, and **Bhopal, Pune, Kolkata, and Chennai are the other four.****​ **
 
• The NGT act directs and gives authority to the central government to form an **NGT to deal with environmental issues.**** **
 
• It is a trained body **begin for the effective and timely resolution of matters involving environmental protection.**
